metadata.title: Output Validity and Uncertainty Management

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for managing the trustworthiness, confidence signaling, and uncertainty of AI-generated outputs.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI inference systems, generative models, decision-support outputs, and human-facing AI interfaces.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how AI system outputs are qualified, constrained, and accompanied by uncertainty and validation signals.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat context for misleading output, hallucination exploitation, and false confidence attacks.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where AI produces plausible but incorrect or misleading outputs that are trusted by users or systems.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where fabricated or incorrect AI outputs go undetected in clinical, legal, academic, or operational contexts.

metadata.remarks: Output Validity and Uncertainty Management defines how AI-generated outputs are bounded, qualified, and contextualized to prevent harm caused by hallucination, overconfidence, or misuse of unverified AI responses. This pattern treats uncertainty disclosure and validation as first-class safety controls.

components.title: Uncertainty Signaling
components.description: Explicit communication of AI confidence, uncertainty, or limits associated with generated outputs.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI systems communicate uncertainty, confidence bounds, or inability to answer in ways that are visible to users and downstream systems.

components.title: Confidence Calibration
components.description: Mechanisms ensuring AI outputs do not convey unjustified confidence or authority.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI systems are designed and evaluated to avoid overstating certainty or authority beyond evidential support.

components.title: Critical Domain Validation
components.description: Additional validation, cross-checking, or human review for outputs used in high-impact or safety-sensitive domains.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI outputs used in safety-critical or high-impact contexts are subject to additional validation or mandatory human review.
